results.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to block 20,000 California midterm ballots
results.content: The Trump administration has appealed to the Supreme Court over claims that a list of more than 20,000 ballots in California include non-US citizens. Multiple courts and independent analysis have rejected the claims.

results.title: What might Trump have planned for Iran following the midterm election?
results.content: While the US midterms could open a window for diplomacy with Iran, they could also unleash a new military escalation. DW spoke with analysts to identify eight factors that could tip the balance toward war or peace.

results.title: Germany's chancellor called for Korean unity. Does Seoul want that?
results.content: Germany, like Korea, was once divided by rival political systems and by one of the world's most fortified borders. Chancellor Merz called for a reunified Korea during his recent visit — but the prospect seems faint.

results.title: Global pedestrian Karl Bushby returns home to UK after 28-year trek
results.content: Karl Bushby, a British man who traveled 50,000 km without transport over the past 28 years, has come home. Starting in Chile, he crossed the Americas, Russia and parts of Central Asia and Europe — almost all on foot.

results.title: How Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria
results.content: Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria, promising to be a "president of peace." But the campaign showed how divided Bulgarians are about the war in Ukraine and drone attacks in the Black Sea.

results.title: Will renewed conflict derail Ethiopia's economic growth?
results.content: Ethiopia's economy is growing strongly. But renewed fighting in the north of the BRICS member state could deter investment, strain public finances and push up the cost of living.

results.title: For US Democrats, climate policy is now about energy bills
results.content: Climate change has all but disappeared from Democrats' campaign pitches, replaced by promises to lower electricity bills. So what would the party really do for climate policy should it win control of Congress?

results.title: US: 9 killed in Florida jet crash
results.content: A Learjet plane crashed near a busy road in a residential neighborhood in Palm Beach County, leaving all nine people on board dead and a large crater on ground.

results.title: Russia's giant new radar in Kaliningrad raises alarm in NATO
results.content: Russia is nearing completion of what experts think is a giant radar complex in Kaliningrad, capable of monitoring much of Europe. Experts warn the project could intensify the military standoff between Moscow and NATO.

results.title: Ethnic Germans in Kazakhstan face legacy of the Soviet Union
results.content: Kazakhstan is struggling to deal with the legacy of the Soviet dictatorship. Some 85 years ago, Stalin deported hundreds of thousands of people: Some 400,000 ethnic Germans living in the USSR were sent to Kazakhstan.

results.title: Biological weapons: The weaponization of disease
results.content: Biological weapons are prohibited under international law. But new developments in biotech and AI are a cause for concern. DW addresses some of the most important questions about their history, risks, and control.
